source_authority: README and current PRODUCT/ROADMAP/DELIVERY; approved imported design blobs, not proposal-status inference
evidence_rules: Every mapped suite/path/function is source-located. No suite is claimed compiled, discovered, reached or passed by this review.
Historical evidence counts belong only to their exact candidate and invocation; no extrapolation to55 registrations.
Missing finalizer names mean exact-name source search absent, not proof all corresponding behavior absent.
Existing test names mentioning roles, super-admin exceptions or employer users do not authorize title-based new workflows.
Direct cargo commands require appropriate pinned toolchain/environment. Prefer supplied PostgreSQL wrappers for real disposable database execution.
No running-empty, compiler/environment failure, missing route or schema prerequisite is accepted as downstream behavioral RED.
New tests must use real owner output/history; static schema/ref validators and fixture checks are not product proof.
